record.context_brief: Finite representable intertwines over finite fields
record.original_question: For any finite field F and any two matroids, are there only finitely many F-representable intertwines of the two matroids, up to isomorphism? Here a matroid M is an intertwine of matroids N1 and N2 when M contains both an N1-minor and an N2-minor, but no proper minor of M contains both.

evidence.quote: A matroid M is an intertwine of two matroids N1 and N2 if M contains an N1- and an N2-minor but no proper minor of M does.
Conjecture 5.1. For any finite field F, there are, up to isomorphism, only finitely many F-representable intertwines for any two matroids.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{F}$ be a finite field. A matroid is said to be $\mathbb{F}$-representable if it is isomorphic to the matroid associated to the columns of some matrix with entries in $\mathbb{F}$. Given matroids $N_1$ and $N_2$, a matroid $M$ is called an intertwine of $N_1$ and $N_2$ if $M$ contains both an $N_1$-minor and an $N_2$-minor, but no proper minor of $M$ contains both an $N_1$-minor and an $N_2$-minor. 

Prove or disprove: for every finite field $\mathbb{F}$ and every pair of matroids $N_1, N_2$, there are, up to isomorphism, only finitely many $\mathbb{F}$-representable intertwines of $N_1$ and $N_2$.
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture is widely attributed to the matroid minors program of Geelen, Gerards, and Whittle. While related intertwining/connectivity statements over finite fields have been established (e.g., intertwining connectivities in representable matroids), no source consulted definitively confirms a full proof of the finiteness of F-representable intertwines for arbitrary pairs of matroids. It is believed to follow from the matroid minors structure theory (well-quasi-ordering of F-representable matroids), but a clear published confirmation could not be verified.

status_evidence.title: Some open problems on excluding a uniform matroid
status_evidence.snippet: Conjecture stated as an open problem about F-representable intertwines being finite.
status_evidence.claim: Posed as an open conjecture in the matroid minors literature.

status_evidence.title: Intertwining connectivities in representable matroids
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes intertwining-type results for representable matroids preserving connectivities.
status_evidence.claim: Related intertwining results over finite fields exist, but do not directly settle the conjecture.

status_evidence.title: Solving Rota's Conjecture (Geelen-Gerards-Whittle)
status_evidence.snippet: Describes the matroid minors project and its structural consequences for F-representable matroids.
status_evidence.claim: The matroid minors structure theory is the framework in which this conjecture is expected to be resolved.
